name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Consultant | SaaS Configuration, Testing & Go-Live | Change Management
summary: Implementation consultant who configures complex SaaS platforms to each customer's requirements, tests before go-live, and documents every decision. At Accelo I scoped and planned implementations of a CRM, project, and billing platform. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. I build and debug my own integrations (webhooks, REST APIs, Zapier, Make, n8n).

Document every client interaction, decision, and deliverable, keeping configuration records auditable for post-launch optimization.
